rec: Necklace of Passage, or a teleport to Tree Gnome Stronghold

st.t: Wear all your ghostly robes, the ring of visibility and the ghostspeak amulet whenever you talk to Khazard or the scouts. Talk to General Khazard just north of the log balance, south-east of Rellekka.
s: I just have one of those faces.

st.t: Climb the ladder in the spinning wheel house in Seers' Village and talk to the Sin Seer upstairs. You need one free inventory slot.
Return to General Khazard south east of Rellekka.
Talk to the scout near The Outpost, south of the Tree Gnome Stronghold.
Talk to the scout west of Draynor Manor.
Talk to the scout south of the Shantay Pass.
Talk to the scout south east of Tai Bwo Wannai.
Return to General Khazard south east of Rellekka.
Enter the cave south east of the Fishing Guild. Be prepared to fight Bouncer (level 160).
Inside the cave, head north, then take the first passage east into a larger cavern. Enter the crack in the south wall of that cavern. You need the severed leg in your inventory.
Kill Bouncer. You cannot use prayers.
